summary: Operator pages + site map read: 51 RV sites (12 FH 30A, 19 FH 50A, 20 W/E), pad lengths 33-63 ft, bathhouse showers, dump; ResNexus booking (refused with Incapsula, so no rate read). Google 4.6 (202). DROP CANDIDATE as an ATV trail-base park; no nightly rate found.
flags: OHV DROP CANDIDATE (reviewer decides): the operator markets the campground as an ATV base with the trail starting at the gate. RV page: 'A thoughtfully designed, stress-free RV site with ... Ride-in, ride-out ATV access — no trailering needed!'; 'Make the most of Minnesota's summer with a seasonal campsite at Trails Inn Quadna Mountain Campground ... your ideal "up north" home base for ATV adventures, lake days, and outdoor recreation.'; 'Our seasonal campsites offer direct access to the Northwoods ATV Trail System, which features over 500 miles of connected trails'. ATV page: 'Enjoy direct access to the Northwoods ATV Trail System ... From our doorstep, you can ride to ...'. The site map's arrow 'ATV / Snowmobile Trails' points straight off the loop to the rail-grade trail along the north edge. The brief puts private parks marketing ATV trails from the campground out; it also sells golf, Hill Lake, fishing and a motel, so a general park with an OHV side is the counter-reading.

PRICE: no nightly rate on any operator page; the ResNexus engine answered with an Incapsula bot challenge and was not retried, so the rate is unread. RV Life (stored) 4 stars / $$ tier. Price gate unresolved. Presence passes (working site with phone; Google 4.6 with 202 reviews and phone +1 218-506-8030).

Long-stay tests: the RV page is titled 'Seasonal RV Campground' and pushes seasonal sites ('Spots are limited and go fast!'), but the same page sells 'a weekend getaway', there is an online nightly engine, and the cancellation policy has separate nightly and 'Monthly and Seasonal' tiers. No share of seasonal vs nightly sites is posted. Esri imagery (older frame, before all rows were built) shows ~12 rigs scattered across the loop with no skirting or decks. Not judged mostly seasonal on the evidence, but the reviewer should weigh it with the ATV flag.
Season: the home page says 'Our facility is open year-round and has 51 RV sites' — not written, because it reads as the motel/business; no campground season stated.
Phone: none stored -> 218-506-8030 (operator site and Google). Website https://www.trailsinnquadna.com/ unchanged.
Pin 46.97210,-93.60080 is on the site loop (Google 46.970784,-93.600162 is the office, ~150 m south); no move. Waterfront 'not waterfront' correct (Hill Lake ~1.5 km).
